title: Excalibur Torch Texture sadFix
description: If you're using other Mods that have Torches and Excalibur is forcing its texture on them, then you could potentially "fix" that with this resourcepack.
body:
Excalibur takes over the Vanilla Torches and turns them into Excalibur version.
This happens to Ice and Fire, and Realistic Torches. So I decided to make a "Fix" for it.

**This is more of a sad-fix as it eliminates Excalibur Torches...
or atleast I think it does x)**

---

**Forgot to mention... In the Images the 3 'Vanilla Torches' on the left side are from (NOT Included In The Resourcepack Fix):**

https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-lights
and some other resourcepack I forgot the name, I was in too much of a hurry setting all of this up x)

_Credits for resources go to the Ice and Fire, Realistic Torches and Mojang. I do not own anything inside this resourcepack.  If you want to use any of their work, ask them!_
